channel.title: Handy Calcs pins
channel.description: Free calculators in English and Spanish.

item.title: Contador de palabras y caracteres en línea (gratis)
item.description: Cuenta palabras, caracteres (con y sin espacios), oraciones y párrafos mientras escribes, más el tiempo de lectura y las palabras más usadas. Gratis.

item.title: How Overtime Pay Is Calculated (Time and a Half Explained)
item.description: How overtime works in the US: who gets it, the 40-hour week rule, time and a half, daily overtime in some states, and examples you can check on your paycheck. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.

item.title: Word Counter and Character Counter (Free, Live)
item.description: Count words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences and paragraphs as you type, plus reading time and most used words. Free.

item.title: How to Convert an Hourly Wage to a Yearly Salary (and Back)
item.description: How to turn hourly pay into a yearly, monthly and weekly salary, why 2,080 hours is the standard, and what changes with part-time, overtime and unpaid time off. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.

item.title: Comprimir imagen a 100 KB, 50 KB o el peso que quieras (gratis y privado)
item.description: Reduce el peso de fotos JPG, PNG y WebP en segundos. Pon un límite como 100 KB o 50 KB. Gratis y sin subir nada: tus fotos no salen de tu dispositivo.

item.title: How to Split a Restaurant Bill Fairly With Friends
item.description: Fair ways to split a check: even split, pay for what you ordered, shared plates, drinks, tax and tip, plus tips to avoid awkward moments at the table. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.
